project_tracker_diagnostic: Woody-based or shrubby white composite with opposite leaves and clusters of discoid white heads; much more shrubby than herbaceous bonesets.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common or useful Central Texas fall/white composite for field learning.

morphology_keys.habit: Rounded shrubby plant, often woody at the base.
morphology_keys.leaves: Opposite, ovate to triangular-ovate, serrate, often aromatic when crushed.
morphology_keys.heads: Small white discoid heads in terminal corymbs or panicles.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
